title: Product Marketing- Agentic Analytics Intern (Spring 2027)
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
Snowflake started as the place companies go to understand their data. Now we're making it the place where AI agents put that data to work: investigating business questions, testing explanations and recommending what to do next, all within the rules people set. The Agentic Analytics Product Marketing team sits at the center of that shift, taking products like Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, semantic views and interactive warehouses to market.
As an Agentic Analytics intern on this team, you'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Sales, Developer Relations and Demand Gen to shape how the market understands and adopts Snowflake's answer to one of the most important questions in data and AI: how do you let agents do real analytical work that the business can trust? You'll get a front-row seat to how products are positioned and launched in the fastest-moving space in tech.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Help develop go-to-market strategy and positioning for Snowflake's agentic analytics portfolio
- Craft messaging that translates complex technical capabilities into clear business value
- Conduct competitive research and market analysis that directly informs product and sales strategy
- Build sales enablement assets, content briefs, and launch materials
- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Developer Relations, and Demand Gen
- Present your work to senior leaders
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Currently pursuing a Master's degree (or equivalent graduate degree)
- Analytical and curious: You like digging into data, competitive landscapes, and customer problems
- A strategic thinker who can zoom out on market dynamics and zoom in on crisp messaging
- Familiarity with databases, semantic layers, cloud platforms, or developer ecosystems
- Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving priorities
WHAT YOU'LL GET
- Real ownership on live go-to-market initiatives
- Exposure to the full GTM machine at a leading AI company, including product, sales, engineering, developer relations, content, demand gen, and more
- A crash course in the Agentic Analytics and enterprise AI context, the market everyone is trying to understand right now
NICE-TO-HAVES
- Prior experience in product marketing, product management, consulting, or technical roles
- Coursework or experience in product strategy, go-to-market strategy, or data analytics
- Excellent writer: You can distill complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives
- Technically fluent: comfortable exploring BI tools and getting hands-on with data products to form your own point of view. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be able to go deep enough to credibly compare technical capabilities.
Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
How do you want to make your impact?
For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com
